database.name: abyssal-warden-synthetic-test
database.description: Synthetic, harmless test indicators for exercising the scan pipeline. Contains no real malware hashes.

signatures.name: AbyssalWarden.Test.SyntheticIndicator
signatures.description:
Matches a file containing exactly "ABYSSAL-WARDEN-SYNTHETIC-TEST-INDICATOR" followed by one newline (40 bytes). Create it with:
printf 'ABYSSAL-WARDEN-SYNTHETIC-TEST-INDICATOR\n' > indicator.txt
signatures.remediation: No action needed: this is a harmless test file.
